english: Scrap Storage Core

The heart of a StashNet storage network. Drive Bays and Terminals within 6 blocks connect to it. Lock it with a code to protect the network's Drive Bays and Terminals. Hit it with a hammer while carrying a Storage Core to upgrade it; the code stays.
Drive Bay
Holds up to 4 storage drives. Only accepts drives. Protected by its network Core's code. Hit it with a hammer while carrying a Reinforced Drive Bay to upgrade it; the drives stay inside.
Storage Terminal
Browse, search, deposit and withdraw everything stored on your network's drives.
Crafting Terminal
A workbench wired into your storage network. Same recipes and skills as a workbench, but it can use ingredients stored on the network's drives (place it within reach of a Storage Core).
Fetching ingredients from storage... click Craft again.
Basic Drive

A crude storage drive. Holds 24 stacks, like a small chest. Its contents stay on the drive, even when removed. Only readable inside a StashNet network. Shift-click it while a Storage Terminal is open to empty its contents into the network.

Standard Drive

A sturdier storage drive. Holds 96 stacks, about two crates. Runs hotter than a Basic Drive. Its contents stay on the drive, even when removed. Only readable inside a StashNet network. Shift-click it while a Storage Terminal is open to empty its contents into the network.
High-Density Drive

A dense late-game storage drive. Holds 384 stacks, about eight crates. Runs the hottest. Its contents stay on the drive, even when removed. Only readable inside a StashNet network. Shift-click it while a Storage Terminal is open to empty its contents into the network.
Reinforced Drive Bay

Holds up to 8 storage drives and takes about as much punishment as concrete. Only accepts drives. Protected by its network Core's code. Hit it with a hammer while carrying an Armored Drive Bay to upgrade it; the drives stay inside.
Armored Drive Bay
Holds up to 12 storage drives and is about as tough as steel. Only accepts drives. Protected by its network Core's code. If it is destroyed, its drives drop in a loot bag.
Storage Core

A better network Core. Drive Bays and Terminals within 12 blocks connect to it, and its drives give off less heat. Lock it with a code to protect the network. Hit it with a hammer while carrying an Advanced Storage Core to upgrade it; the code stays.
Advanced Storage Core
The best network Core. Drive Bays and Terminals within 24 blocks connect to it, and its drives give off the least heat. Lock it with a code to protect the network.
